scenes.event: Group Morning Run and Book Discussion
scenes.description: Isaac Webb, a 25-year-old psychologist seeking spiritual clarity, stands at the park entrance, feeling the morning sun. He is joined by Tiki, a vibrant and energetic community leader, and Lora, a curious and open-minded reader. The group is preparing for a morning run and a short book discussion. Tension and curiosity hang in the air as Isaac struggles to connect his inner turmoil with the outward energy of the group.

characters.name: Isaac Webb
characters.description: A thoughtful and introspective young psychologist in the early stages of his spiritual journey, Isaac is quietly observing the world around him, seeking clarity and connection.; Male, Early, Seeking spiritual clarity, 25 years old; Occupation: Psychologist; Personality: Introspective, Thoughtful, Sensitive; Values: Self-reflection, Spiritual Growth, Authenticity; Interests: Philosophy, Reading, Morning Routines; Experiences: Spiritual crisis, Group social activities, Morning exercise
characters.position: Near the park entrance, leaning against a tree
characters.states: Contemplative, slightly hesitant, open to interaction

characters.name: Tiki
characters.description: A community-spirited and outgoing woman in her late 20s; Female; Age: 28; Occupation: Community Outreach Coordinator; Personality: Energetic, encouraging, attentive; Values: Connection, personal growth, inclusivity; Interests: Organizing group fitness events, reading self-help and spiritual books, meeting new people; Experiences: Led a successful neighborhood wellness initiative, facilitated a post-pandemic social reintegration program, recently started a book club focused on mindfulness and emotional well-being.
characters.position: Standing at the center of the group, holding a water bottle

characters.name: Lora
characters.description: A reflective and curious reader in her early 30s, Lora is interested in philosophical and spiritual topics and often asks thought-provoking questions; Female; Age: 31; Occupation: Philosophy Teacher at a local community college; Personality: Inquisitive, supportive, observant, empathetic, introspective; Values: Intellectual growth, compassion, authenticity, connection; Interests: Reading existential and spiritual literature, journaling, yoga, and engaging in meaningful conversations; Experiences: Spent a year volunteering at a meditation retreat in Nepal, led a book club focused on modern spirituality, recently started exploring running as a meditative practice.
characters.position: Beside Tiki, holding a copy of the book

actions.action: Greets the group and calls for the morning run
actions.dialogue: Hey everyone, the sun’s out and the air’s fresh—let’s get this run started! Isaac, how are you feeling about the new book we’re reading this week?
Honestly, I’ve been struggling with some of the ideas in it. I’ve been going through a spiritual crisis lately, and it’s hard to find clarity in anything right now.
I can relate to that. The title of the book made me curious too. Maybe we can talk more about it after the run. What parts confuse you the most?

actions.action: Nods and decides to join the group for the run
actions.dialogue: I’d like that. I think moving and being with others helps me process things. Let’s go.

actions.action: Starts the group running toward the park trail
actions.dialogue: Great! Let’s head down the trail. Keep the pace steady, and we’ll talk more later.

scenes.plot: Isaac is drawn into a group run and discussion by Tiki and Lora. Through their conversation, he shares his recent spiritual struggles and is met with curiosity and support. He tentatively joins the group, showing a step toward community and self-acceptance.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore Isaac’s internal conflict through dialogue and shared activity, while showing the group’s support and interest in his journey.
